evidence.evidence_text: To do so, we conduct a model review on Hugging Face to reveal the availability of models to cover various moderation rules and guidelines from three exemplar forums.
We further put state-of-the-art LLMs to the test, evaluating how well these models perform in flagging violations of platform rules from one particular forum.
Finally, we conduct a user survey study with volunteer moderators to gain insight into their perspectives on useful moderation models.
